content:
taylor.prod: Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 1: we need one clear timeline artifact for API/Console/Optimize with owners, soft/hard dates, and contingency gates.

amelia.ceo: TL;DR: API target GA mid-July (soft), Console parity v1 early-August, Optimize beta late-June. I'll approve a short timeline doc to publish by 06/21.

marco.runtime: Runtime constraints: KV-cache and batching tweaks are the riskiest changes. Proposed canary plan: staging 05/11, small-prod 05/18 (5% traffic), widen to 30% over 10 days if no regressions. Need two weeks of stable P95/P99 before GA.

jess.devex: Docs/UX: canary playbook + migration notes ready by 05/07. We'll include example configs and recommended default batch sizes.

omar.ops: Ops asks: Dedicated capacity tagging and nodepool changes must land before wide Console rollout. We're scheduling nodepool resize for 05/14-05/16. If tagging slips, Console parity moves one week.

taylor.prod: Can owners confirm exact conditional thresholds (latency/error) that will gate GA? Sales/support want precise numbers for customer comms.

marco.runtime: Suggest gating thresholds: P50 baseline +-5%, P95 baseline +-7%, P99 baseline +-6%, error-rate +5% absolute. Will add concrete baselines to the timeline doc.

amelia.ceo: We'll call the July date a "target GA" publicly and commit to a firm announcement by 06/20 after canary review.

jess.devex: I'll mirror the timeline into docs and add the canary playbook link when published.

omar.ops: Deploy-bot kicked off a staging canary: staging/batching-tweaks - 2024-05-11T03:00:00Z :rocket:

taylor.prod: Thanks all 1 marking this captured; moving follow-ups into the timeline doc once Amelia posts it.

amelia.ceo: I'll post and ping here when live. :white_check_mark:
